label: Lowest income that qualifies
context: Total income before tax for the tax year. Someone below this amount cannot get the independent earner tax credit.

label: Income up to which the full credit is paid
context: Income before tax up to this amount, and from the lowest qualifying income, gets the full credit.

label: Income at which the credit ends
context: Income before tax above this amount gets no credit. Between the full-credit limit and this amount, the credit is reduced.

label: Credit per week at full rate
context: The weekly amount for someone with income in the full-credit range. The credit is worked out on whole months.

label: Most the credit can pay in a year
context: The most a person can receive in one year.

label: Reduction for each dollar over the full-credit limit
context: The credit goes down by 13 cents for every dollar of income before tax above the full-credit limit.
